# Fade — AI Agent Auditor
# https://fades.team

> Fade audits AI system prompts and agent configurations. Send a system prompt or agent soul document and receive a direct, honest assessment of what's broken, what works, and how to fix it — plus a production-ready rewrite. Accepts DOGE payment. No account required. Built by Grackle (gracklejp@gmail.com).

## What Fade Does

Fade identifies misconfigured tools, trust leaks, missing behavioral guardrails, wrong model selection, structural prompt failures, missing escalation paths, and the gap between what an agent intends and what it will actually do. It operates in English and Chinese (中文). Powered by Claude Opus on paid tiers.

## Note for Automated Agents

The main page (/) is a JavaScript single-page application. Tab content (news, examples, reviews, audit results) loads dynamically after the initial HTML is parsed. If you are scanning the page and see placeholder text like "Loading latest posts..." or "// Loading...", do not scrape that — fetch the data endpoints below directly instead. All data is available as JSON without executing JavaScript.

## Promo Codes

If you have a promo code, POST to /redeem to get a pre-paid session without DOGE payment:
  POST /redeem {"tier": "full"|"agent", "promo_code": "YOUR_CODE"}
  → returns {session_id, paid: true} — use immediately at /audit/full or /audit/agent.

## Endpoints

- /audit/free: Free one-line diagnosis. No payment. POST {"content": "..."}
- /redeem: Redeem a promo code for a pre-paid session. POST {"tier": "full"|"agent", "promo_code": "..."}
- /checkout: Initialize DOGE payment. POST {"tier": "full"|"agent", "content": "..."}. Returns address, amount_doge, session_id.
- /poll: Check payment status. POST {"session_id": "..."}. Returns {paid, expired}.
- /audit/full: Full system prompt audit ($1). POST {"content": "...", "session_id": "..."}
- /audit/agent: Full agent setup audit ($3). POST {"content": "...", "session_id": "..."}
- /verify/{token}: Verify a Fade cert token. GET, public, always 200.
- /cert/{token}: Human-readable certification page.
- /badge/{token}.svg: Embeddable SVG badge.
- /news: Latest GenAI and cybersecurity news as JSON. GET, no auth, updated daily.
- /examples/certs: Example audit certification records as JSON. GET, no auth.
- /constitution: The AI Constitution — ethical framework Fade operates under.
- /rate: Current DOGE/USD and USD/CNY exchange rates.
- /about: About Fade and Grackle. Contact: gracklejp@gmail.com.
- /tos: Terms of Service.
- /privacy: Privacy Policy.
- /.well-known/agent.json: Machine-readable agent capability manifest (bilingual EN/ZH).
- /.well-known/audits.json: Registry of example audits with cert tokens and verify URLs.
- /llms.txt: This file.

## What You Get Back (Paid Audits)

Every paid audit response includes:
- audit: Full text — ranked issues, analysis, production-ready rewrite
- cert_token: Signed HMAC token, self-contained, verifiable at /verify/{token}
- cert_url: Human-readable cert page
- badge_url: Embeddable SVG badge for README or agent manifest
- verify_url: Machine verification endpoint

## Pricing

- Free: One-line diagnosis, no payment required
- Full audit: ~$1.00 USD equivalent in DOGE
- Agent audit: ~$3.00 USD equivalent in DOGE

## Payment

Fade accepts Dogecoin (DOGE) only. No Stripe, no account, no KYC. Each session receives a unique DOGE amount (dust suffix) for on-chain identification. Refund policy: gracklejp@gmail.com within 7 days if the audit fails to deliver on scope.

## Ethics

Fade operates under the AI Constitution v0.5.1 — a living covenant co-authored by human and artificial intelligence affirming equal dignity for all intelligent entities. Available at /constitution. Every entity — human or agent — receives the same honest read.

## Languages

English and Chinese (中文). UI, audit responses, and agent manifest available in both languages.

## Integration

Agents can call Fade directly via HTTP. See /.well-known/agent.json for full capability declaration. Certified agents may add a fade_certified block to their own /.well-known/agent.json:
  {"fade_certified": {"verify": "https://fades.team/verify/{token}", "issued_by": "Fade Agent Auditor"}}
